article.title: Hermosillo, Mexico
article.excerpt: To paraphrase Samuel Johnson, when a man is tired of Mexico he is tired of life and death. My short time here has been just splendid: 1. From the air one sees many enclaves of small condominiums and townhomes, a’ la Orange County. This is the Mexico of the future. 2.
